pluginsDefinition: A plugin adds skills or tools to Codex. It may include applications that need a connected account.
applicationsDefinition: An application connects Codex to a service and its data, with the permissions of your account.
mcpDefinition: An MCP server exposes tools for Codex to read data or act on a service.
directoryUnavailable: The application catalog is temporarily unavailable. The upstream request failed; your connected inventory remains separate.
inventoryUnavailable: The connected application inventory could not be loaded.
cachedInventory: Refresh failed. The last successful inventory is still displayed.
associationDescription: Continue to the provider to choose the account and review its permissions. Return here and refresh after connecting.
associationUnavailable: The service has not provided a connection URL.
serverScope: Configuration for the Codex instance running in Mergeron. Desktop settings and credentials are not imported. Project permissions still apply.
oauthAfterSave: For OAuth, save the server then use its sign-in action. A token variable must already exist in the server environment; no secret is entered here.
argumentsInvalid: Arguments must be a JSON array of strings.
localCommandHint: This command runs in the container with the CLI environment. The executable must be available there. It does not change agent permissions or network filtering.
checkReloads: Checking reloads all configured MCP servers, then reads their reported tools and authentication state.
serverSaved: Configuration saved. Check the reported status and sign in if required.
serverReported: Server reported: {{count}} tools · authentication: {{auth}}. This does not test every tool.
serverNotReported: The server is not yet reported. Check runtime status and configuration.
internalServerHelp: Internal Mergeron tools. Connection and available tools are checked per conversation under Capabilities → MCP servers, according to project permissions.
